    Interval structure of string coefficient components #

    Orienting every matched coefficient edge by increasing source-word index makes the edge relation a partial bijection. Church--Rosser then shows that each connected coefficient component embeds in both word-position lines. This is the graph-theoretic core of identifying graph-map components with oriented common intervals.
